text:
Mira: follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. need a concise roll-up: who owns final sign-off and what are the gating checks for (A) adaptive batching for Hosted + Dedicated, (B) console per-route cost breakdown, (C) Optimize auto-suggestions UI. trying to avoid last-minute surprises for customers/docs.
Raj: owners: (A) eng-runtime, lead Jamal; (B) billing team + console UX, lead Lin; (C) optimize team, lead Priya.
Zoe: quick ask on (B) 1 per-route cost numbers: is that a derived estimate or raw billing tag? customers expect line-item accuracy.
Lin: good question. plan is derived estimate based on route token counts + backend tag mapping. we'll surface both: "estimate" label and link to raw usage export for reconciliations.
Priya: Optimize UI note: initial canary will only show suggestions, not auto-apply. need approval window to extend to A/B apply.
Mira: deadlines? marketing needs firm weeks for blog + example notebooks.
Raj: tentative dates: batching canary 2024-07-01, batching open beta 2024-07-29. console per-route internal preview 2024-08-05, public roll 2024-08-19. Optimize suggestions UI canary 2024-07-10, review 2 weeks after.
Zoe: for accounting: if we show "estimate" in console we need a tooltip copy and a link to CSV export. Lin can you own copy?
Lin: yes I will own tooltip copy and an internal doc explaining rounding and attribution edge-cases.
Priya: canary data requirements: need 45 days of eval logs for suggestion-quality metrics. Ops ok with retention?
Mira: ops gave conditional OK for 45 days if orgs opt-in for the canary. Trevor from infra to confirm.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-deploy/batching on 2024-07-01 02:30 UTC. health-checks: p95 latency, error spike threshold, KV cache-eviction rate monitor.
deploy-bot: note: canary window 72h, automatic rollback on error-rate > 1.5x baseline.
Raj: technical gating for batching: (1) no p95 regression > 10% on production traffic shapes, (2) cache-hit impact < 2% SLA, (3) documented SDK flag and migration guide.
Mira: SDK flag name? please avoid confusing names.
Priya: suggest `enable_adaptive_batching: true` in SDK config for clarity. example: `client.updateConfig({enable_adaptive_batching:true, batching:{max_latency_ms:20}})`
Zoe: good. add a short blurb about request ordering changes in the SDK-breaking notes.
Lin: UI gating for console cost: must have feature-flag `cost_v2_preview` and backend tags stable for 3 days before public preview.
Priya: UX ask: show a beta badge and a feedback link in the console for early users. we'll collect qualitative signals.
docs-bot: docs request: please attach a sample route and token-profile to the ticket so docs can generate reproducible screenshots.
Mira: action items: (1) Raj/Jamal publish migration guide + sample route by 2024-06-20, (2) Lin produce tooltip copy and CSV link by 2024-07-25, (3) Priya to confirm retention opt-in flow and widget by 2024-06-28, (4) Trevor/infra to confirm ops approval and post load-test results in eng-sre by 2024-06-22.
Zoe: small billing note: finance wants an internal preview of estimated vs real for at least one large customer before public launch. Raj can you route the sample?
Raj: yes will coordinate with accounts and anonymize data.
Mira: perfect. I'll compile these items into the post-all-hands doc and ping owners on Monday. thanks all.
Priya: ack. will add the UX mockups to the canary ticket.
Lin: will schedule a sync with billing on Monday.
Trevor: infra will run the batch-shape sweep on 2024-06-21 22:00 UTC (4h). will post metrics in eng-sre.
Mira: closing thread 1 will follow up with the summary and link back here.
